sources.snippet: Introduction We present SlideChat, the first open-source vision-language assistant capable of understanding gigapixel whole-slide images. We have released model weight.

sources.title: SlideChat - uni-medical.github.io
sources.snippet: SlideChat is the first large vision-language assistant specifically designed for whole-slide pathology analysis. SlideChat can generates comprehensive descriptions of whole-slide images and provides contextually relevant responses across various applications.

sources.title: GitHub - uni-medical/SlideChat: SlideChat: A Large Vision-Language ...
sources.snippet: We release SlideChat, SlideInstruction, and SlideBench as open-source resources, hoping to facilitate research and development in computational pathology. SlideChat: The first large vision-language assistant for whole-slide pathology image analysis, capable of generating comprehensive descriptions and contextually relevant responses.
